language_hh_limited_english_count_geo20.long_description: Count of households classified as having limited English proficiency, where no member aged 14 or older speaks English 'very well.' Communities with high counts of linguistically isolated households face barriers to accessing government services, healthcare, emergency information, and civic participation. This measure helps identify areas where multilingual outreach and translation services are most needed.
language_hh_limited_english_count_geo20.long_name: The count of households with limited English.
language_hh_limited_english_count_geo20.provenance: Directly tabulated from ACS 5-year estimates, table C16002 (Household Language by Household Limited English Speaking Status). Limited English households summed across four language groups: Spanish (C16002_004), Indo-European (C16002_007), Asian/Pacific Islander (C16002_010), and other languages (C16002_013). Percentages calculated relative to total households (C16002_001).
language_hh_limited_english_count_geo20.short_description: Count of households with limited English.
